reason: A dsh web GUI settings panel for listing installed plugins and enabling or disabling their runtime entries by updating profile patch configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web GUI 的设置页面中列出已安装插件，并通过修改配置补丁启用或禁用插件条目。
summaries.en: Adds a dsh Web GUI settings panel that lists installed plugins and enables or disables their runtime entries through profile patch configuration.

capabilities: Lists installed plugins and runtime loader entries
Reads profile package and patch configuration files
Writes profile or home cordis.patch.yml files to enable or disable plugin entries
Exposes same-origin POST endpoints for plugin state changes
Triggers runtime patch reload through dsh HMR
